data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'g-l-l' which means 'to flow', Galila is a name of Arabic origin that conveys the idea of joy, gladness, and grace. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the inner peace and contentment that comes from living a life in accordance with the teachings of the Quran. The name Galila carries the meaning “Joy, gladness, and grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Galila usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, gladness, and grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
